Diff inspection is documented only generically (cursor-docs-4), with nothing tying it to JetBrains. missing for 10: documentation of a JetBrains plugin or ACP-in-JetBrains workflow, interactive diff viewing inside JetBrains, sharing selected code as context from JetBrains, and any hands-on corroboration.
